About this app

SDR MSi Driver provides rtl_tcp compatible streaming from MSi2500/MSi001 based SDR devices (SDRplay RSP1A, RSP2, Mirics dongles).

It allows SDR applications to receive raw I/Q samples over TCP from MSi.SDR hardware on Android.

Notes and license

This app is open source. The source code can be found on github.com/olexii4/sdr-msi-driver

Modified version of libmirisdr (renamed libmsisdr)
